title: Design: Service For column keeps its place when Open only is switched
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billed to customer B and paid in full, so it is not open.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, invoiced, unpaid, that bills itself.
  • Open customer B's Invoices tab and make sure "Open only" is switched on.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p5-02-after-a-j-invoices.png, bt-p5-04-after-valders-open-only-off.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Take a screenshot of the page.
  2. Switch "Open only" off.
  3. Switch "Open only" on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Only work order 2's invoice is listed.
  • A "Service For" column shows after No., blank on work order 2's row.
  • You have a picture of where each heading, field and button sits before the change.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1's invoice is listed too, with customer A's name under Service For.
  • Every column heading is in the same place as in your screenshot: none has moved left or right.

Step 3:

  • Only work order 2's invoice is listed.
  • The "Service For" column still shows.
  • Every column heading is in the same place as in your screenshot: none has moved left or right.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-N1: “The "Service For" column is hidden when no row on the tab, before any search, is billed for someone else.”
  • S10-R6: “The Bill To's Invoices tab shows a "Service For" column naming the customer the work was for.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "A & J, Invoices" (page 5 "Getting paid", This build), "Valders, Open only off" (page 5 "Getting paid", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p5-02-after-a-j-invoices.png
  • bt-p5-04-after-valders-open-only-off.png

The design's own words:

  • “New column after No.: header "Service For", naming the customer the work was for.”
  • “S2-17581, Service For "Buda Truck Repair", Paid.”

The PRD says the column is hidden when no row on the tab, before any search, is billed for someone else; it does not name the Open only switch, and the design draws the column moving Date, Type, No. and Memo when it appears. These results follow the suggested answer of question 16; the case is released or rewritten when Chris Ward answers.
